description: Record element and setting states into an open Inbox Clearance pass: before/after values your agent read live, each confirmed, unverified with its reason, or failed with its reason. Unknown ids are refused — password, 2FA, passkey and recovery changes are excluded by construction. Free under the perpetual license.

audit.description: Third-party access audit entries (report only, capped at 200)

action.description: Report only — the tool never revokes

after.description: Value read back live after the change, or null

before.description: Value read live before the change, or null

reason.description: The exact reason — required when state is unverified or failed

state.description: confirmed, unverified (reason required), or failed (reason required)

elements.description: Per-element records keyed by element id (the 17 runbook ids)

license_key.description: The license key issued once by inbox_clearance_buy

pass_id.description: The pass id returned by inbox_clearance_open_pass

settings.description: Per-setting records keyed by setting id (the 8 runbook ids)

name: inbox_clearance_record_pass
title: Inbox Clearance — Record Pass
